objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed document created, edited, released, distributed, revised, archived, invalidated, reactivated and translated in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type selected when creating a new document or information object; can include policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions and other document types.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Level used to differentiate documents for clarity and evaluation options.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation of the document; not language-independent and same for all languages.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Consecutive number assigned to the document.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata of the document that can be printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata of the document that can be printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata of the document that can be printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used for assigning reader authorizations via User Groups.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute used for assigning the author and personal authorizations; creator is automatically confirmed in this field by default.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute used for assigning additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute used for assigning reviewers.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute used for assigning releasers.

attributes.name: translation
attributes.description: Attribute mentioned with releaser for translation authorization assignment.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the validity period count starts; updated for each newly released version.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate the Valid Until date; defined for each document type.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from Valid From and Period Of Extended Validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents are retained; defined for each document type.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose later change affects e-mail notification when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose later change affects distribution of the workflow task when the next version is released.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type used for company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type used for locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures within a framework, process sequence, details and responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type used to document detailed work steps relevant for few departments.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template that can be defined for each document type and selected when creating new objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or new documents generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Object attached in the system when creating new documents, additional information, attachments, or requests.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Entity to which documents already in the system can be automatically linked; local documents may reference original documents for local additions.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Entity to which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Entity to which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data, such as IT applications, to which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Example of Master data to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Object type added to a document for additional information that is released and published directly via switches in properties and not subject to main document release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attachment associated with a main document, automatically released with the main document and subject to its own versioning.

objs.name: form
objs.description: Additional form that can supplement work instructions.

objs.name: checklist
objs.description: Additional checklist that can supplement work instructions.

objs.name: equipment
objs.description: Relevant equipment mentioned as additional information for describing documents in more detail.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person using DHC VISION, assigned to groups, roles, authorizations, workflow tasks, distribution lists or signatures.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used to assign authorizations, roles, readers, distribution, archive access, and dashboard relevance.

objs.name: authorization_group
objs.description: Group defined in the system and assigned specifically to documents so read and change rights can be assigned to users or persons.

objs.name: role
objs.description: System role implemented to provide users with appropriate functions according to their area of application.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: Role or participant who can view approved objects and dependent objects and can take note of documents.

objs.name: author
objs.description: Role or participant who receives read and write permissions and signs creation in the first workflow step.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: Role or participant with personal change rights and no relevance within the release workflow.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: Role or participant who checks document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: Role or participant responsible for the document and its content and for deciding distribution to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: Role or participant who can translate released content into another language and cannot create new objects independently.

objs.name: creator
objs.description: User who creates a document, Change proposal, or request and may act as initiator or workflow participant.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants, completed with electronic signature for release processes or without signature for acknowledgement.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification sent to users involved in workflow, document author, proposal creator, distribution recipients, and acknowledgement recipients.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for an existing document that belongs to a document, is displayed in the document, and can be scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document 30 days before validity expires, processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request for invalidating a selected released document and archiving it and its attachments.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to re-validate invalidated documents; only Business Admin group is permitted to create it.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of User Groups and persons assigned to distribution for a document, granting read authorization and driving e-mail or acknowledgement distribution and dashboards.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation requested from persons or users of User Groups when a document with acknowledgement distribution is released.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific dashboard filled based on distribution groups and showing relevant documents.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report available for documents, instructions, workflow status and acknowledgements.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated language-dependent version of released document content, checked and released with workflow support.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group retaining read access to archived documents.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting the corresponding document type.

evts.name: select_document_type
evts.description: Select the corresponding document type when creating a new document.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select one or more document templates defined for a document type when creating a new object.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Create a pure object cover for uploads or generated documents.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: edit_document_property
evts.description: Maintain standardized and customer-specific metadata in document properties.

evts.name: maintain_attribute
evts.description: Maintain attributes such as references, IT applications, relevant companies or areas of validity via document properties.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit document content with an implemented editing client in the corresponding local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save a document after content editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically and system-supported convert the saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_document
evts.description: Display the current converted document version on the web or in dashboards.

evts.name: change_released_document
evts.description: Make changes to released documents, resulting in creation of a new editing version.

evts.name: link_document
evts.description: Automatically link documents already in the system with processes, organizational units, risks, other documents and Master data.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group and person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: assign_reader
evts.description: Assign reader authorizations via User Group assignment in the Reader attribute.

evts.name: assign_author
evts.description: Assign author authorization and read/write permissions to a document.

evts.name: assign_co_author
evts.description: Assign additional personal change rights via the Co-authors attribute.

evts.name: assign_reviewer
evts.description: Assign reviewers in the reviewer attribute with read and write permissions.

evts.name: assign_releaser
evts.description: Assign releasers in the releaser attribute with read and write permissions.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add an object of type Additional info to a document.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add an Attachment to a document.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release and publish additional information directly via switches in properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an Attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark released Attachments for archiving and archive them with release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: delete_attachment
evts.description: Delete Attachments where allowed; released Attachments cannot be deleted.

evts.name: start_approval_process
evts.description: Initiate the approval process after document creation, attribute and content maintenance, and definition of document control.

evts.name: start_release_process
evts.description: Start the three-step release process consisting of Creator, Review and Release.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Registered author signs the creation of the document in the first workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewers check the content of a document according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releasers complete release, after which the document is automatically published and visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: Reject during review or release, causing workflow cancellation for subsequent participants after the first rejection.

evts.name: send_e_mail_notification
evts.description: Send e-mail notifications about workflow task status, proposal creation, proposal editing, validity extension, distribution, acknowledgement or override.

evts.name: complete_workflow_task
evts.description: Workflow participants complete tasks with an electronic signature, or acknowledgement tasks without a signature.

evts.name: document_signature
evts.description: Document signatures of individual participants in the system for each released version.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish a document after release.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new version of a valid released document in editing status when revised or when scheduled Change proposals are implemented.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid and released document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a Change proposal for a document without affecting the content or version history.

evts.name: manage_change_proposal
evts.description: Create and manage Change proposals in the Cockpit for a document in the Change proposals folder.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a Change proposal for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents the editing of assigned Change proposals directly in the Change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete Change proposals so they are no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before Valid Until date.

evts.name: process_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Process the request for validity extension with workflow support.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, delete the request for validity extension and update the Valid Until date.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: Automatically terminate validity extension when a revised new version is released or when suspension has been declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Create a request for AKS for a selected document to invalidate it.

evts.name: start_aks_workflow
evts.description: Workflow for processing the request for AKS starts automatically after attachment of the request.

evts.name: check_request_for_aks
evts.description: Creator of the request checks the request and the document in the first step of the AKS process.

evts.name: review_aks
evts.description: Reviewers carry out review of AKS.

evts.name: approve_aks
evts.description: Releasers carry out approval of AKS.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Declare documents and attachments invalid and archive them.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Archive documents by revoking authorizations except for the archive group.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete documents after archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation in the folder provided and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Workflow for a reactivation request starts automatically.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Creator of the request confirms reactivation.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Create a new version of an invalidated document and restore metadata, properties, authorizations and distribution list.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Reactivate attachments archived with the document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain User Groups and persons assigned to distribution in the cockpit for the document.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_e_mail
evts.description: Inform directly assigned users and users of assigned User Groups by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request persons and users of assigned User Groups by e-mail to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement through workflow support without a signature.

evts.name: evaluate_document
evts.description: Evaluate documents, instructions, workflow status or acknowledgements using role-specific reports and dashboards.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content and documents into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Check translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release translated version so document is visible to authorized readers in corresponding login language.

evts.name: specify_document_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible or not in a multi-client system.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client for a local addition to a document.

evts.name: reference_original_document
evts.description: Create a reference from a local document to the original document.

External files or documents can be uploaded to a pure object cover or new documents generated based on Office formats.

Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with organizational units.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with risks.

Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with Master data.
IT applications are given as example of Master data.
Additional information can be added to each document and is displayed as a detail of documents.
Attachments are associated with a main document and released with it.
Work instructions can be supplemented with additional forms.
Work instructions can be supplemented with checklists.
Documents can be supplemented with relevant Equipment.
Users can be assigned to User Groups.
System roles are implemented to provide individual users with functions.
Authorization groups are defined in the system and assigned specifically to documents for groups of users/persons.
Authorization groups are assigned specifically to documents to grant read and change rights.
Readers may view approved document objects and dependent objects.
A document has an author maintained in its properties.
A document can have co-authors maintained in its properties.

A document can have releasers maintained in its properties.

Users assigned to Reviewer User Groups are offered in the reviewer selection list.
Users assigned to releaser user group are offered in the releaser selection list.
Workflow tasks are created in workflows for document release and acknowledgement.
Users involved in workflows receive and complete workflow tasks.
Workflow participants complete release tasks with an electronic signature.
Signatures are documented for each released version and can be printed as document content.
A Change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in the document.
Creator of a proposal receives e-mail notifications when the proposal is edited.
Request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
Request for AKS is created for a selected document.
Request for reactivation selects the corresponding invalidated document.
Distribution list is maintained for each document.
User Groups can be assigned to the Distribution list.
Persons or directly assigned users can be assigned to the Distribution list.
Acknowledgements are requested and documented for released document versions.
Persons and users of assigned User Groups confirm acknowledgement.
User and role-specific dashboards list documents relevant to the user.
Documents assigned through Distribution are shown in dashboards.
Reports evaluate documents stored in the system.
A report lists acknowledgements depending on status.
A translated language version belongs to a released document and becomes visible after release.
For each document in a multi-client system, visibility in clients can be specified.
Only the Business Admin group is permitted to create requests for reactivation.
Archive group retains read access to archived documents.
Policy is a document type.
Guideline is a document type.
Procedural instruction is a document type.
Work instruction is a document type.
